itemConfig.name: Item Settings
itemConfig.label: Configure Item Settings
itemConfig.hint: Configure how the module reads data from Foundry item documents.
itemConfig.nameAttributeHint: Dot-notation path to the item's display name. Defaults to 'name' (the standard Foundry item name property).
itemConfig.priceFormatHint: How this system stores item prices. Simple: a single number (standard currency assumed). Denomination Field: a number plus a separate denomination string. Denomination Object: an object whose keys are currency abbreviations.
itemConfig.formatDenominationObject: Denomination Object (object with currency abbreviation keys)
itemConfig.priceAttributeHint: Dot-notation path to the item's price value. Leave blank if items have no price. Examples: system.price, system.cost, system.price.value
itemConfig.priceDenominationAttributeHint: Dot-notation path to the denomination string (e.g. system.costDenomination). The value must match a configured currency abbreviation. Only used with the Denomination Field format.
itemConfig.formatManual: Manual (GM sets prices when adding items)

currencyConfig.name: Currency Configuration
currencyConfig.label: Configure Currency
currencyConfig.hint: Configure the currency system used by all city interactions.

hoursPerDay.name: Hours Per Day
hoursPerDay.hint: Number of in-game hours in a single day. Used to calculate time-based events.

daysPerWeek.name: Days Per Week
daysPerWeek.hint: Number of in-game days in a week. Used to calculate weekly schedules.

currency.modeLooseHint: Untracked currency. When a purchase occurs, the total cost is whispered to the GM and the purchasing player so they can adjust records manually.
currency.modeAttributeHint: Currency is stored as a numeric attribute on the character sheet. Each currency must have a dot-notation attribute path configured.
currency.modeItemHint: Currency is represented by item documents in the world. Each currency must be linked to a specific item.
currency.listHint: Define denominations ordered as you prefer. Drag to reorder.
currency.isStandardHint: The standard currency is the base for all exchange rates (always 1:1). Only one currency should be standard.
currency.exchangeRateHelp: Enter as A:B — where A of the STANDARD currency equals B of THIS currency.
currency.attributePathHint: Dot-notation path on the actor data model (e.g. system.currency.gp).
currency.itemHint: Search and select the item document that represents this currency.

purchase.title: Purchase
purchase.fillTooltip: Add enough of this currency to cover the remaining cost

error.cannotMakeChange: Cannot make exact change using the highest denomination entered.
